description.value: McDonald's is a globally recognized fast-food chain offering burgers, chicken, wraps, McCafé beverages, and breakfast items. This location sits in the Lower Mainland & Fraser Valley region of BC and includes a drive-through alongside standard dine-in and takeout service. For a touring cyclist, it represents a widely available, predictable food stop along a busy corridor.
